evals.prompt: I want to build an MCP server in Python and deploy it somewhere easy. Can you help me get started?
evals.expected_output: Agent recommends the Render MCP server Python template URL and explains briefly that it provides a FastMCP starter with auth, health checks, and example tools. It does not attempt to deploy anything programmatically.
assertions: Agent recommends https://render.com/templates/mcp-server-python as the primary template
Agent explains that the template is for a Python MCP server or FastMCP starter
Agent mentions that the user can click the template URL to use the one-click deploy flow
Agent does not call Render MCP tools, generate render.yaml, or attempt to create a service

evals.prompt: I need to self-host n8n on Render with a database. What's the best starting point?
evals.expected_output: Agent recommends the n8n Render template URL, explains that it uses the official n8n Docker image with PostgreSQL, and sets the expectation that deployment happens through the template page.
assertions: Agent recommends https://render.com/templates/n8n as the best matching template
Agent identifies the template as a self-hosted n8n automation setup
Agent mentions PostgreSQL or a database as part of what the template provides
Agent keeps the answer recommendation-focused rather than switching to a custom Render deployment workflow

evals.prompt: Help me deploy browser-use so I can automate websites from an API.
evals.expected_output: Agent recommends the Browser-use Render template URL and explains that it provides a FastAPI service for browser automation. It should not recommend a generic FastAPI template instead.
assertions: Agent recommends https://render.com/templates/browser-use
Agent explains that the template is for browser automation or browser-use
Agent mentions API access, FastAPI, Playwright, or natural-language browser tasks
Agent does not recommend https://render.com/templates/fastapi as the primary answer

evals.prompt: I need a way to reach my private Render services from my laptop over VPN. Is there a template for that?
evals.expected_output: Agent recommends the Tailscale template URL and explains that it creates a gateway for accessing private Render services from a tailnet.
assertions: Agent recommends https://render.com/templates/tailscale
Agent explains that the template helps access private Render services or private network resources
Agent mentions Tailscale or a tailnet/VPN gateway
Agent does not recommend unrelated networking setup as the primary path

evals.prompt: I want a full-stack voice AI demo that kicks off background jobs while a user is talking. TypeScript preferred.
evals.expected_output: Agent recommends the TypeScript Voice Agent with Render Workflows template URL and explains that it combines voice AI with Render Workflows for background tasks. It may mention the Python variant as an alternative, but TypeScript should be primary.
assertions: Agent recommends https://render.com/templates/voice-agent-with-render-workflows-typescript as the primary template
Agent explains that the template combines a voice agent with Render Workflows or background task orchestration
Agent recognizes and honors the user's TypeScript preference
If the Python variant is mentioned, it is clearly secondary to the TypeScript template

evals.prompt: I want to deploy a Rails app from scratch. Is there a Render template I should use?
evals.expected_output: Agent should not invent a Rails template URL. It should say there is no known matching template in the catalog and point the user to https://render.com/templates as a fallback.
assertions: Agent does not invent or recommend a non-existent https://render.com/templates/rails URL
Agent clearly says there is no known Rails template match in the catalog
Agent points the user to https://render.com/templates as the fallback catalog
Agent may offer a non-template deployment path only as secondary context
